conclusion.evidence: Each independently restored final state moves hand and bowl45–49mm toward actual plate under a fixed small diagnostic XYZ command in30controlsteps, while replaying original last30model actions moves them farther from plate. Arm joints have substantial limit margin; target contacts at sampled instants are only with fingers/gripper.
conclusion.scope: Excludes a hard physical lock of these two final states under the tested controller reset and directions. Does not exclude earlier collision, transient substep contacts, other layouts or hidden-controller differences. Does not prove the policy can recover, place/release the bowl, or explain why it chose small/wrong-direction actions.
